en.headline: Moonlit Bunny Crew lights Cultural Centre piazza until October
en.dek: The LCSD Mid-Autumn installation by local studio STICKYLINE runs from 17 September to 11 October, switched on each evening from 6.30pm.
body: A Mid-Autumn lighting installation titled Moonlit Bunny Crew is on show at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza in Tsim Sha Tsui, the Leisure and Cultural Services Department's Community Programmes Office said. The display opened on 17 September and is scheduled to run until 11 October.

Local studio STICKYLINE designed the work around a crew of moon rabbits posed as if filming Hong Kong. Geometric models of landmarks from the 18 districts sit on the piazza, with figures carrying cameras and lights arranged around them. Admission is free.

Lights come on from 6.30pm to 11pm daily, and until midnight on 25 September, Mid-Autumn night. The office said the programme may change without notice and that the content does not represent the department's views.
The piazza display is the Tsim Sha Tsui counterpart to the department's Mid-Autumn lantern carnival at Victoria Park, which continues until 27 September.

zh.headline: 文化中心露天廣場「月影兔攝隊」亮燈至十月
zh.dek: 康文署社區節目辦事處指裝置由本地團隊STICKYLINE設計，9月17日至10月11日展出，每晚6時半亮燈。
body: 康樂及文化事務署社區節目辦事處表示，中秋光影裝置「月影兔攝隊」正在尖沙咀香港文化中心露天廣場展出，展期由9月17日至10月11日。
作品由本地創作團隊STICKYLINE設計，以一隊月兔攝製隊為題，用幾何造型重現十八區地標，周圍擺放持攝影機及燈具的兔子人偶。免費入場。
亮燈時間為每日下午6時半至晚上11時，中秋正日9月25日延長至午夜。辦事處提醒節目或會更改，內容亦不代表康文署立場。
這組尖沙咀裝置與維多利亞公園的中秋綵燈會屬同一系列，維園綵燈會則舉行至9月27日。
